issues: 480×270 设计坐标放大，chip 只有 40×24 设计 px，网格挤在左上角一小块
药丸、连线、徽标都很细小，字幕灰色小字，结果组没有分量
全片灰底黑白，没有光、没有强调色，「接上了」这一刻没有情绪
镜头最后一段几乎静止，结尾不像一张完整画面
changes: look 换 lime 石墨暗场 + 荧光黄绿，按 1080p 原生重排：4×3 缩写网格 chip 168×100、40px 字，眉题「Design team · 12 online」（虚构协作产品 Wren）
入场按到目标距离由中心向外错峰；反色改为暗场里的深灰→近白 3 档台阶（每档 2f），余项按曼哈顿距离扩散退场 + 缩 0.9
药丸左缘锚定生长到 640px，人名 48px 逐字升起 + 职能副标签；荧光绿在线点 overshoot 弹出带光环与落地泛光
连接线改为 3px 荧光绿渐变 + 领跑光点，抵达即 Wren 徽标 spring 弹入；60px 字幕逐词加深、末词人名染强调色，32px 副句交代上下文
机位：生长段静止，定型后 smooth 横移上移到结果组居中并推近 5%，hold 再缓推 1.5%；时长 150→165f
issuesEn: Built in 480×270 design units; chips are 40×24 design px and the grid is squeezed into a small top-left patch
The pill, connector and badge are all thin and small and the caption is small grey text, so the result group has no weight
Grey and black-and-white throughout, with no light and no accent; the moment of connecting has no emotion
The final stretch is almost static and the end doesn't read as a finished frame
changesEn: Lime graphite dark look with fluorescent yellow-green, re-laid natively at 1080p: a 4×3 grid of 168×100 initials chips with 40px type and a "Design team · 12 online" eyebrow (fictional collaboration app Wren)
Chips enter outward from the target by distance; the inversion is a 3-step dark-grey→near-white hard cut (2f per step) and the rest exit by Manhattan distance while shrinking to 0.9
The pill grows from its anchored left edge to 640px, the 48px name rises letter by letter with a role tag, and a lime online dot pops with a halo and floor glow
The connector is a 3px lime gradient with a leading spark; on arrival the Wren badge springs in; the 60px caption deepens word by word with the name in the accent, plus a 32px context line
Camera stays still while the pill grows, then smoothly pans and lifts to centre the result group with a 5% push and a further 1.5% during the hold; 150→165f
